text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having crossed the finish line of her 
Debut, Vivlos declared her ambition to 
conquer the Tiara route. Hearing this, the 
spectators placed immense expectations on 
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Vivlos's body had not yet fully 
matured, and immediately after the race, 
she showed much heavier exhaustion than 
the other girls.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer and Vivlos talked it over and 
decided to focus on training until early 
spring next year, while also working on 
expanding her fanbase.
